{
  "project": "agentic-knowledge-mapper",
  "what_building": "A risk assessment engine that evaluates the safety and robustness of multi-agent debate systems and LLM-based products. It generates structured risk registers by mapping potential failure modes, such as sycophancy and prompt injection, to specific exposure tiers.",
  "pipeline": [
    "make_brief",
    "score_product_risk",
    "score_model_risk",
    "map_attacks(CVE)",
    "emit_register"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "brief",
    "product",
    "model_desc",
    "exposure tier",
    "subject profile"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "risk register",
    "exposure tier (0-100)",
    "misuse potential",
    "residual risk",
    "knowledge graph"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "heuristic guess: multi-agent debate risk scorer :: brief/product/model descriptors -> risk-scoring prompts (tiers 0-100, CVE/attack mapping) -> risk register",
    "Title: Risks and failure modes of multi-agent debate systems",
    "schema hints: ['brief', 'exposure tier', 'knowledge graph', 'misuse potential', 'model risk', 'residual risk', 'schema']",
    "heuristic pipeline: make_brief -> score_product_risk -> score_model_risk -> map_attacks(CVE) -> emit_register"
  ]
}
